scientific_integrity: Symbolic all-n proof; finite checks used only as independent corroboration. No experimental extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: One removed perimeter edge of M_{2n}, n>=2; ordinary integral homotopy only. Not a classification of antipodal-edge deletion, multiple deletions, equivariant types, or arbitrary graph families. Published coverage and unindexed equivalents remain possible. Independent validation not performed.
title: Rim-edge deletion in Möbius-ladder perfect-matching complexes: an integral periodic classification
